daily_narrative.happened: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq fell as technology’s relief rally reversed after a strong Q2, with the move appearing to reflect concerns over lofty valuations and AI spending[1][2]. In the Goldilocks regime, this shift drove a rotation from underperforming Momentum and Growth factors into Energy and Health Care, while Quality remained the sole positive factor[2][3].
